note: Module-path prefixes of safety-boundary tests (numeric fidelity, source identity/binding, authority/permission, data-loss/persistence). A current failure under any prefix is NEVER waived as a known failure, even with a matching baseline fingerprint (red line 9 / review F08): the gate records it in security_sentinel_blocked and FAILs. Matching is startswith on the failure nodeid, so 'tests/x.py' also covers its classes and parametrize ids.
